A certain sum of money is made up of Re. 1, 50 paise, and 25 paise coins. The ratio of the number of these coins is 2.5 : 3 : 4. Then, 3/5th of the Re. 1 coins is changed to 50 paise and 25 paise coins, such that the ratio of the total number of these coins in the same order became 1 : 2. Now, half of the 50 paise coins are changed to Re. 1 coins and all the 25 paise coins are changed to Re. 1 and 50 paise coins in the ratio of 7 : 1. What is the ratio of the Re. 1 and 50 paise coins at the end of the conversions?

properties.html: 1140 students filled the form for UPSC, JEE and SSC CGL. 195 boys filled the form for only two exams, 400 boys filled the form for UPSC and 254 boys filled the form for JEE. 50 boys filled the form for only SSC CGL and JEE but not UPSC. The number of boys who filled all the three forms is 105. The number of boys who filled the form for only JEE is 24. The number of girls who filled the form for UPSC and SSC CGL but not JEE is equal to the number of boys who filled the form JEE and SSC CGL but not UPSC. The number of girls who filled the only SSC CGL is 75, only JEE is 48 and only UPSC is 138. The number of girls who filled the form for UPSC and SSC CGL together is 130, SSC CGL and JEE together is 105 and UPSC and JEE together is 120. How many forms were filled for UPSC exam?
